origin.description: Alias of assertNames. Returns the value when it is a character vector of names. Otherwise it stops with the check message.
origin.usage: assert_names(x, type = "named", subset.of = NULL, must.include = NULL, permutation.of = NULL, identical.to = NULL, disjunct.from = NULL, what = "names", .var.name = vname(x), add = NULL)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Value under test. A Python int is an R integer and a Python float is an R double.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: Name check to apply.

arguments.name: subset.of
arguments.text: Names that must be drawn from this set.

arguments.name: must.include
arguments.text: Names that must all be present.

arguments.name: permutation.of
arguments.text: Names that must be a permutation of this set.

arguments.name: identical.to
arguments.text: Names that must match this vector, including order.

arguments.name: disjunct.from
arguments.text: Names that must not appear in this set.

arguments.name: what
arguments.text: Word used for the names in the message.

arguments.name: .var.name
arguments.text: Name used in the assertion message.

arguments.name: add
arguments.text: Collection that stores the message instead of stopping.

origin.details: Alias of assertNames. Returns the value when it is a character vector of names. Otherwise it stops with the check message.
origin.value: The value when the check passes. Otherwise the check stops.
